items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Kirpatrick was in the band a long time... Kirpatrick was out of the band after we left.

ctx.x: And then there was Truehard and Don Kirpatrick.
Don Kirpatrick was a piano player and arranger. Great arranger.
But he was eventually replaced by Tommy (inaudible).
